data.narrative:
Black Forest Labs, a Series B–stage AI & Software company founded by Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, and Patrick Esser, is evaluated against a peer set of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) operating in the same sector and stage band. The current stated valuation of $3.25B was excluded from analysis due to a sanity check failure: it implies a 20x multiple on the $300M total raised to date, suggesting potential data quality issues in the funding tracker source.

The peer-median method was applied across 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—including Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C), and Together AI ($8.3B, Series C)—yielding a median valuation of $10.0B with a range spanning $2.0B to $39.0B. Stage-progression methodology was not applicable due to the unreliable base value. With only one triangulation method producing reliable output, the analysis supports a valuation range of $8.5B to $11.5B, centered on $10.0B.

Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion across the peer set (19.5x spread from minimum to maximum), heterogeneity in peer stage distribution, and limited public market reference points. The median should be weighted accordingly pending additional operational metrics and revenue data.
